title: Free tutorial: One group membership to domain admin
summary: Follow an attack path from a helpdesk account to Domain Admins, one relationship at a time.
tools: Identity and access (review and attack paths)

next.title: Seminar 7: Identity from both sides: AD, Entra and cloud IAM

script.intro: Welcome. In Active Directory, one group membership can be the whole attack. You will follow the path from a phished helpdesk account to Domain Admins.
script.outro: You found the path; now you can cut it. Seminar 7 covers both sides of identity: Active Directory, Entra and cloud IAM.
steps: Read the setting so you know the company, the date and the time zone. Then open the evidence in the case folder.

Switch sides and think like the attacker. In the Attack paths tab, start at h dot verma, the phished account, and ask for paths to Domain Admins. Each arrow is one thing the attacker can do with what they already have. HasSessionOn means a saved login: whoever is admin on app02 can take the credentials of the admin who logs in there, and a scheduled task keeps that login there every night. Read the path arrow by arrow. The cheapest place to break it is usually one membership, one session, one task.
You found the path; now you can cut it. Seminar 7 covers both sides of identity: Active Directory, Entra and cloud IAM.
